svg.text: Memory Decoder at Scale — paper view

The mechanism as Wei et al. describe it: retrieval happens once, offline, to build a training signal; inference is two frozen forward passes plus a fixed-weight interpolation. Lane = canonical stage (METHODOLOGY-SKELETON §2.2); empty lanes are stages this mechanism does not have.
